subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Future of Film Movements
description: A 60-second lesson on The Future of Film Movements.

hook.text: Every film movement started with a group of frustrated artists saying 'enough.'

buildup.text: Movements emerge when the mainstream can't express what a generation needs to say.

discovery.text: Today's movements might come from Lagos, Seoul, or a teenager's bedroom with a phone.

twist.text: In the streaming age, movements may form online rather than in cafés or film schools.

climax.text: The drive to make something new when the old way fails is cinema's permanent engine.

punchline.text: The next movement has already started somewhere.

quiz.question: What is the common origin of all film movements?
options: Artists rejecting the mainstream to express something new
